scope: Generator event analysis; no matched Fortran/native ratio validation

selection.particles: per-sample particle_level: native partons use status 3/4/5; hadron samples use final flag; exclude neutrino PDG 12/14/16

soft_drop.untagged: null zg and groomed_mass; counted separately

selection.mass: FastJet signed invariant mass in GeV; negative values retained

geometry_matching.assignment: hepyy_utils.match_hard_legs: maximize matches then minimize total distance
geometry_matching.order: all positive-pT jets before analysis cuts

selection.recoils: per-run keep_recoils flag; use projected_particles when projection is enabled, otherwise subtracted_particles when subtraction is enabled, otherwise raw hadronized_particles

normalization: weighted jets per denominator record: attempted events for native runs and ledger-backed Fortran; otherwise written Fortran events; not cross-section normalized or directly comparable without a configuration/normalization audit

run.scope: experimental PPJJ ISR+MPI; incomplete topology and cascade validation
